title: Exactness of finite constant etale sheaf sequences
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\Lambda$ be a finite ring, and let $0\to K\to L\to N\to0$ be an exact sequence of finite left $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The associated constant sheaves on the small etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] form an exact sequence $0\to K_X\to L_X\to N_X\to0$ of sheaves of left $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves].

source.place: Lemma 03RX (lemma-kernel-finite-locally-constant), assertion (3), using Modules on Sites Lemma 093U (lemma-kernel-finite-locally-constant)

proof.text: By the definition of the constant sheaf, each $K_X$, $L_X$, and $N_X$ is the sheafification of the corresponding constant presheaf on the small etale site of $X$, and the maps are the sheafifications of the maps of constant presheaves.

The sequence of constant presheaves is sectionwise the given exact sequence $0\to K\to L\to N\to0$: evaluation at every etale object $U\to X$ gives exactly the module sequence. Therefore it is exact in the category of presheaves of $\Lambda$-modules, since kernels and cokernels of presheaves of modules are computed sectionwise.

Applying the exact sheafification functor to this presheaf exact sequence preserves its kernels and cokernels, so the resulting sequence of sheaves is exact; by Step 1 its terms and maps are precisely $0\to K_X\to L_X\to N_X\to0$.

proof_origin.place: Modules on Sites, Lemma Tags 03CS and 03EI
